meta.framing: The screens below are captured from the live product. One seeded student — the 73% receipt — is illustrative, labeled wherever it appears. No outcome stats, no pricing: capability facts only.

hero.eyebrow: Veradic · The AI platform for schools
hero.headline: See what your class actually understands — and what they don't.
hero.subhead: One platform for the whole teaching loop. Veradic checks true understanding through a short one-on-one chat — what a grade alone can't show you — and gives you the full conversation and the reasoning behind every call, so nothing it surfaces is a black box. It reveals exactly what your class has mastered and where it's slipping, backed by grading scored with a per-problem receipt and problem sets tuned to your course generated in minutes. Nothing auto-posts; a teacher approves every call.

flow.eyebrow: A day in your teacher's life
flow.title: One simple loop — from your course to a class you can actually see
flow.sub: Not four separate tools to learn. One connected workflow, start to finish. Watch how little the teacher actually has to do.

useCases.title: Four pieces that change the week — open any one
useCases.sub: Each is a real, working surface. Step into it to see the actual product, end to end, with the system's own output.

cards.title: The understanding check
cards.benefit: Catches the smooth memorizer that one graded answer can't. A calm three-minute chat per student — and the kid never sees a verdict, so a teacher always makes the call.

cards.title: AI grading you can defend
cards.benefit: Every problem scored with a receipt — 100 − 20 − 7 = 73% — sitting right next to the handwriting it came from. You review the few it's unsure about and sign off.

cards.title: Problem generation
cards.benefit: Turn your course into a ready-to-assign set in minutes — every problem independently re-derived, figures and worked solutions included, so the answer key is never quietly wrong.

cards.title: Your teaching week
cards.benefit: Walk in to a to-do list, not a scoreboard — the few students who need you surfaced first, then turn a class-wide gap into ten practice problems in one click.

roi.title: What it's worth to you
roi.sub: Veradic grades every paper and runs the understanding check; you still see every one — but a quick review of its work is far faster than grading from scratch. Drag your own class through the model below — the arithmetic is right there, nothing hidden.

payoff.title: What this gives a school that stands behind it.
payoff.lead: Not another tool to roll out and babysit. Three things a head of education can put their name to — in every classroom, for every student:

points.title: Every teacher gets their evenings back
points.body: The grading and the understanding check run on their own — teachers review only the handful that need a human, not the whole stack at 10pm. And there's almost nothing to learn — a photo, a review, a click; no training program to roll out.

points.title: Integrity you can stand behind
points.body: Every grade itemized and traceable; every understanding call conservative, and the student never sees a verdict — so a teacher always makes the final call. Across our adversarial test set, zero honest students were ever falsely flagged. Reputation you can defend to any parent.

points.title: No student quietly falls behind
points.body: You see where every student is — the whole class, not a sampled five — with the ones slipping and the concepts the class is missing surfaced before the test does it for you.

payoff.closing: Evenings back for every teacher. Integrity you can put your name to. And every student seen, so no one slips through. That's the whole point.
